purpose: A closed read projection for a Work Request captured from a current sourced routine answer. It specifies what an authenticated server-side reader may return; it does not add capture, triage, claim, approval, dispatch, or execution transport to the static Control Room prototype.

authority.source_reader: mcp-server search-doctrine response with current source and reconstructible provenance

transport: authenticated MCP-backed read, not implemented by this static prototype

output.human_ref: durable human-readable Work Request reference; never a database UUID

source.label_rule: exact source label from the current retrieved result; never a generated summary

triage.rule: present only for canonical triaged rows; it is durable readback, never an action authority

plan.rule: immutable plan hash, bounded scope summary, and persisted references only; never commands or caller-authored steps

outcome_feedback.rule: null until a human authority accepts one exact immutable evidence proposal; then exposes only the durable safe outcome readback. It is observational feedback, never execution, completion, release, approval, or a state transition.
outcome_feedback.measurement_rule: Observed minutes, interaction surface, heavy-session use, and manual context transfers are observations for later displacement comparison only. They do not claim displacement or retire an old ritual.

outcome_feedback_history.rule: the deterministic oldest-to-newest last 20 human-accepted outcome feedback receipts; pending proposals never appear
outcome_feedback_history.item: the same closed safe fields as outcome_feedback

output.accepted_feedback_count: count of all human-accepted immutable outcome feedback receipts for this Work Request; it is not a completion count

shape.rule: durable derived shape disposition and fixed surface reference only; never caller-controlled

prohibitions: derive canonical state from a UI label
interpret accepted outcome feedback as success, displacement, execution, completion, or a state transition
accept a client-supplied tenant, actor, or source reference
expose a raw database UUID as the human label
copy business payload or raw question text into the projection
add POST, dispatch, claim, approve, or execute routes
integration_boundary: An authenticated server-side reader must validate tenant and actor scope, current source freshness, and provenance before returning this projection. Capture and transition ownership remain in the MCP/record-layer implementation. Outcome-feedback proposal and human acceptance remain separate record-layer writes; the reader returns accepted receipts only.
